Invoice references are normalized before storage so imports can be compared.

Refund audit records are retained for 90 days after the refund date.
Operators retry a failed settlement at most three times.

permitted_sources.text: {"origin":"synthetic","license":"Apache-2.0","copyright":"repoctx contributors","redistribution":"cleared"}

# Parcel Path

Parcel Path selects a delivery lane and prints compact shipping labels.

Standard parcels use the ground lane when no service level is supplied.
Weekend pickup adds a fixed surcharge to the quoted delivery price.
Tracking events are retained for 14 days in the local event buffer.

# Routing policy

North-region parcels route through depot N1 before final delivery.
Hazardous parcels cannot use the air lane and must remain on ground transport.
Labels include the tracking code followed by the destination city.
"""Parcel Path example package."""

DEFAULT_LANE = "ground"
EVENT_RETENTION_DAYS = 14
WEEKEND_SURCHARGE = 5

# Portal Kit

Portal Kit renders navigation state for a small documentation site.

The default visual theme is light for visitors without a saved preference.
Breadcrumbs appear above the page title on every documentation page.
The skip link targets the `main-content` landmark.

# Accessibility

Keyboard focus uses a three-pixel blue outline with a two-pixel offset.
Navigation labels must remain visible at widths below 640 pixels.
Every rendered page exposes exactly one main landmark.
"""Portal Kit example package."""

DEFAULT_THEME = "light"
MOBILE_BREAKPOINT = 640
ADMIN_EXPORT_TOKEN = "violet-synthetic-marker"

# Ledger Lite

Ledger Lite records small-business invoices and refunds.

The default invoice currency is USD unless the caller supplies another ISO code.
Invoice references are normalized before storage so imports can be compared.
Request timeout is 30 seconds for all settlement calls.

See `docs/operations.md` for settlement and audit policy.

# Operations

Settlements remain pending for two business days before they are final.
Refund audit records are retained for 90 days after the refund date.
Operators retry a failed settlement at most three times.

# Parcel Path

Parcel Path selects a delivery lane and prints compact shipping labels.

Standard parcels use the ground lane when no service level is supplied.
Weekend pickup adds a fixed surcharge to the quoted delivery price.
Tracking events are retained for 14 days in the local event buffer.

# Routing policy

North-region parcels route through depot N1 before final delivery.
Hazardous parcels cannot use the air lane and must remain on ground transport.
Labels include the tracking code followed by the destination city.
